facts.fact: The WURI-Niger project page says a digital platform for managing civil-status events is in service in 100 communes, with extension planned to 166 more (266 in all, matching its 266 principal centres); it states the platform's deployment, not that the commune offices are connected, and gives no date, so the date is the page's proxy publication year.
